m_35e503d2d060.message: A plain keyword is usually enough. Append || to specify matching options or an exclusion rate for that line. When multiple lines match, the first one takes priority.

m_38a228d04f09.message: word||rate:90 hides 9 of every 10 matching posts. rate:90! shows the first and hides the next 9. Rates use scan-order cycles, not randomness. The default and rate:100 hide every match.

reloadRequired.message: The extension was updated. Please reload this page.

reportFilterEmpty.message: No rows match the selected decisions.

guideKeyword.message: Posts hidden by a matching exclusion keyword.

guideExcluded.message: Posts hidden as a result of AI classification.

guidePending.message: Posts awaiting a result while AI classification is on and conditions are configured, including queued requests, requests in progress, request limits, missing API keys, and provider-wide pauses or retry delays.

guideError.message: Posts with a recorded classification or storage error. See Decision status for the cause.

guideVisible.message: Posts shown normally without being excluded, including posts shown while AI classification is off, no conditions are configured, filtering is off, or all posts are temporarily shown.

thresholdHelp.message: Lower values broaden what counts as related and hide more posts.

reportTooLarge.message: The decision report is too large to open. Reduce the number of conditions and try again, or copy the details as TSV.

keywordMatchedVisible.message: Matches a keyword, but is visible because filtering is off or all posts are temporarily shown.

settingsReloadNotice.message: Settings opened in a separate tab because the extension is not yet running on the X page. Reload the original X page to open settings over that page.
